rule: Group-stratified by scenario-level F1 pattern, then by sorted scenario ID. Persistent failures (fail in both versions) are TRACE-S04, S09, S13. Mixed (fail in exactly one version) are TRACE-S01, S08, S15, S20. All other scenarios pass in both versions. Calibration takes the first two persistent IDs, the first mixed ID, and the first seven pass-pass IDs. Validation takes the remainder. Both versions of a scenario stay in the same group. The split was frozen before judge inference and was not chosen from judge performance.
validation_note: Validation examples are held out from judge-prompt refinement; they are not unseen capstone scenarios.
